1.english_reference: The LORD also spake unto Joshua , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐλάλησεν Κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et locútus est Dóminus ad Iósue , dicens :
traditions.KJV: The LORD also spake unto Joshua , saying ,

traditions.VUL: Lóquere fíliis Israel , et dic eis :

2.english_reference: Speak to the children of Israel , saying ,

traditions.WLC: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.KJV: Speak to the children of Israel , saying ,

2.english_reference: Appoint out for you cities of refuge ,

traditions.WLC: תְּנ֤וּ לָ כֶם֙ אֶת עָרֵ֣י הַ מִּקְלָ֔ט
traditions.VUL: Separáte urbes fugitivórum ,
traditions.KJV: Appoint out for you cities of refuge ,

2.english_reference: whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses :

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵי כֶ֖ם בְּ יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
traditions.LXX: ἃς εἶπα πρὸς ὑμᾶς διὰ Μωυσῆ .
traditions.VUL: de quibus locútus sum ad vos per manum Móysi :
traditions.KJV: whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses :

3.english_reference: That the slayer that killeth [ any ] person unawares [ and ] unwittingly may flee thither :

traditions.WLC: לָ נ֥וּס שָׁ֨מָּ ה֙ רוֹצֵ֔חַ מַכֵּה נֶ֥פֶשׁ בִּ שְׁגָגָ֖ה בִּ בְלִי דָ֑עַת
traditions.LXX: φυγαδευτήριον τῷ φονευτῇ τῷ πατάξαντι ψυχὴν ἀκουσίως ·
traditions.VUL: ut confúgiat ad eas quicúmque ánimam percússerit néscius ,
traditions.KJV: That the slayer that killeth [ any ] person unawares [ and ] unwittingly may flee thither :

3.english_reference: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood .

traditions.WLC: וְ הָי֤וּ לָ כֶם֙ לְ מִקְלָ֔ט מִ גֹּאֵ֖ל הַ דָּֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσονται ὑμῖν αἱ πόλεις φυγαδευτήριον , καὶ οὐκ ἀποθανεῖται ὁ φονευτὴς ὑπὸ τοῦ ἀγχιστεύοντος τὸ αἷμα , ἕως ἄν καταστῇ ἐναντίον τῆς συναγωγῆς εἰς κρίσιν .
traditions.VUL: et possit evádere iram próximi , qui ultor est sánguinis :
traditions.KJV: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood .

4.english_reference: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נָ֞ס אֶל אַחַ֣ת מֵ הֶ עָרִ֣ים הָ אֵ֗לֶּה וְ עָמַד֙ פֶּ֚תַח שַׁ֣עַר הָ עִ֔יר
traditions.VUL: cum ad unam harum confúgerit civitátum , stabit ante portam civitátis ,
traditions.KJV: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city ,

4.english_reference: and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city ,

traditions.WLC: וְ דִבֶּ֛ר בְּ אָזְנֵ֛י זִקְנֵ֥י הָ עִֽיר הַ הִ֖יא אֶת דְּבָרָ֑י
traditions.VUL: et loquétur senióribus urbis illíus ea , quæ se cómprobent innocéntem :
traditions.KJV: and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city ,

4.english_reference: they shall take him into the city unto them ,

traditions.WLC: ו וְ אָסְפ֨וּ אֹת֤ וֹ הָ עִ֨ירָ ה֙ אֲלֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.VUL: sicque suscípient eum ,
traditions.KJV: they shall take him into the city unto them ,

4.english_reference: and give him a place , that he may dwell among them .

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתְנוּ ל֥ וֹ מָק֖וֹם וְ יָשַׁ֥ב עִמָּֽ ם
traditions.VUL: et dabunt ei locum ad habitándum .
traditions.KJV: and give him a place , that he may dwell among them .

5.english_reference: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him ,

traditions.WLC: וְ כִ֨י יִרְדֹּ֜ף גֹּאֵ֤ל הַ דָּם֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔י
traditions.VUL: Cumque ultor sánguinis eum fúerit persecútus ,
traditions.KJV: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him ,

5.english_reference: then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand ;

traditions.WLC: ו וְ לֹֽא יַסְגִּ֥רוּ אֶת הָ רֹצֵ֖חַ בְּ יָד֑ וֹ
traditions.VUL: non tradent in manus eius :
traditions.KJV: then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand ;

5.english_reference: because he smote his neighbour unwittingly , and hated him not beforetime .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י בִ בְלִי דַ֨עַת֙ הִכָּ֣ה אֶת רֵעֵ֔ הוּ וְ לֹֽא שֹׂנֵ֥א ה֛וּא ל֖ וֹ מִ תְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם
traditions.VUL: quia ignórans percússit próximum eius , nec ante bíduum triduúmve eius probátur inimícus .
traditions.KJV: because he smote his neighbour unwittingly , and hated him not beforetime .

6.english_reference: And he shall dwell in that city , until he stand before the congregation for judgment ,

traditions.WLC: וְ יָשַׁ֣ב בָּ עִ֣יר הַ הִ֗יא עַד עָמְד֞ וֹ לִ פְנֵ֤י הָֽ עֵדָה֙ לַ מִּשְׁפָּ֔ט
traditions.VUL: Et habitábit in civitáte illa , donec stet ante iudícium , causam reddens facti sui ,
traditions.KJV: And he shall dwell in that city , until he stand before the congregation for judgment , [ and ]

6.english_reference: [ and ] until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days :

traditions.WLC: עַד מוֹת֙ הַ כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה בַּ יָּמִ֣ים הָ הֵ֑ם
traditions.VUL: et moriátur sacérdos magnus , qui fúerit in illo témpore :
traditions.KJV: until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days :

6.english_reference: then shall the slayer return , and come unto his own city , and unto his own house , unto the city from whence he fled .

traditions.WLC: אָ֣ז יָשׁ֣וּב הָ רוֹצֵ֗חַ וּ בָ֤א אֶל עִיר וֹ֙ וְ אֶל בֵּית֔ וֹ אֶל הָ עִ֖יר אֲשֶׁר נָ֥ס מִ שָּֽׁם
traditions.VUL: tunc revertétur homicída , et ingrediétur civitátem et domum suam de qua fúgerat .
traditions.KJV: then shall the slayer return , and come unto his own city , and unto his own house , unto the city from whence he fled .

7.english_reference: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּקְדִּ֜שׁוּ אֶת קֶ֤דֶשׁ בַּ גָּלִיל֙ בְּ הַ֣ר נַפְתָּלִ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ διέστειλεν τὴν Κάδης ἐν τῇ Γαλειλαίᾳ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Νεφθαλεί ,
traditions.VUL: Decreverúntque Cedes in Galilǽa montis Néphthali ,
traditions.KJV: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת שְׁכֶ֖ם בְּ הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ Συχὲμ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Ἐφράιμ ,
traditions.VUL: et Sichem in monte Ephraim ,
traditions.KJV: and Shechem in mount Ephraim ,

7.english_reference: and Kirjatharba , which [ is ] Hebron , in the mountain of Judah .

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּ הַ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν πόλιν Ἀρβόκ , αὕτη ἐστὶν Χεβρὼν ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Ἰούδᾳ .
traditions.VUL: et Cariathárbe , ipsa est Hebron in monte Iuda .
traditions.KJV: and Kirjatharba , which [ is ] Hebron , in the mountain of Judah .

8.english_reference: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward ,

traditions.WLC: וּ מֵ עֵ֜בֶר לְ יַרְדֵּ֤ן יְרִיחוֹ֙ מִזְרָ֔חָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου
traditions.VUL: Et trans Iordánem contra orientálem plagam Iéricho ,
traditions.KJV: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward ,

8.english_reference: they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben ,

traditions.WLC: נָתְנ֞וּ אֶת בֶּ֧צֶר בַּ מִּדְבָּ֛ר בַּ מִּישֹׁ֖ר מִ מַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֑ן
traditions.LXX: ἔδωκεν Βόσορ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς Ῥουβήν ,
traditions.VUL: statuérunt Bosor , quæ sita est in campéstri solitúdine de tribu Ruben ,
traditions.KJV: they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben ,

8.english_reference: and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת רָאמֹ֤ת בַּ גִּלְעָד֙ מִ מַּטֵּה גָ֔ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἀρημὼθ ἐν τῇ Γαλαὰδ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Γάδ ,
traditions.VUL: et Ramoth in Gálaad de tribu Gad ,
traditions.KJV: and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad ,

8.english_reference: and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh .

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת גלון בַּ בָּשָׁ֖ן מִ מַּטֵּ֥ה מְנַשֶּֽׁה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν Γαυλὼν ἐν τῇ Βασανείτιδι ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Μανασσή .
traditions.VUL: et Gaulon in Basan de tribu Manásse .
traditions.KJV: and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh .

9.english_reference: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel , and for the stranger that sojourneth among them ,

traditions.WLC: אֵ֣לֶּה הָיוּ֩ עָרֵ֨י הַ מּֽוּעָדָ֜ה לְ כֹ֣ל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ לַ גֵּר֙ הַ גָּ֣ר בְּ תוֹכָ֔ ם
traditions.LXX: αὗται αἱ πόλεις αἱ ἐπίκλητοι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ τῷ προσκειμένῳ ἐν αὐτοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: Hæ civitátes constitútæ sunt cunctis fíliis Israel , et ádvenis , qui habitábant inter eos ,
traditions.KJV: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel , and for the stranger that sojourneth among them ,

9.english_reference: that whosoever killeth [ any ] person at unawares might flee thither ,

traditions.WLC: לָ נ֣וּס שָׁ֔מָּ ה כָּל מַכֵּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּ שְׁגָגָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καταφυγεῖν ἐκεῖ παντὶ παίοντι ψυχὴν ἀκουσίως ,
traditions.VUL: ut fúgeret ad eas qui ánimam néscius percussísset ,
traditions.KJV: that whosoever killeth [ any ] person at unawares might flee thither ,

9.english_reference: and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood , until he stood before the congregation .

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֣א יָמ֗וּת בְּ יַד֙ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַ דָּ֔ם עַד עָמְד֖ וֹ לִ פְנֵ֥י הָ עֵדָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνῃ ἐν χειρὶ τοῦ ἀγχιστεύοντος τὸ αἷμα , ἕως ἂν καταστῇ ἔναντι τῆς συναγωγῆς εἰς κρίσιν .
traditions.VUL: et non morerétur in manu próximi , effúsum sánguinem vindicáre cupiéntis , donec staret ante pópulum expositúrus causam suam .
traditions.KJV: and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood , until he stood before the congregation .
